title: Menene darajar dannawa? Gwanjon da lambobi

say: Menene darajar dannawa? Gwanjon da lambobi.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module 1 na Tallan da Aka Biya tare da Tallace-tallacen Google.
Yawancin tallace-tallace suna katse mutane. Tallan bincike yana nunawa ne kawai bayan wani ya buga abin da yake so a cikin Google.
Lokacin da wani mutum a Ibadan ya rubuta inverter shigarwa kusa da ni, tana gaya muku bukatarta, wurinta da sau da yawa ta sauri. Wato ana kiran niyya nema.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi

Sanin abin da abokin ciniki ke da daraja da farko

say: Kowane bincike yana gudanar da sabon gwanjo tsakanin masu talla waɗanda kalmomin su suka yi daidai. Babu wanda ya rubuta madaidaicin wuri.

say: Google yana ba kowane maɓalli mai inganci daga 1 zuwa 10. Yi la'akari da shi azaman hasken faɗakarwa. Yana da sassa uku.
Na farko, ƙimar danna-ta hanyar da ake tsammanin, ko CTR: yadda yuwuwar danna tallan ku.

cards.d: Yaya yuwuwar danna tallan ku. Saka kalmomin mai nema da bayyanannen tayin a cikin kanun labarai.
Yadda tallan ya yi daidai da binciken. Raba kalmomin shiga cikin jigogi masu tauri, buƙatu ɗaya ga kowane talla.
Yaya amfanin shafin ke bayan dannawa. Aika mutane zuwa shafin da ya dace, da sauri akan wayar hannu.

say: Na biyu, dacewar talla. Idan wannan yana da ƙasa, ƙila kalmar tana zaune a rukunin talla mara kyau.

say: Na uku, gogewar shafi na saukowa. Idan wannan ya kasance ƙasa da matsakaici, tallace-tallace masu wayo ba za su gyara shi ba. Gyara shafin.
A kwas misali, Installer A ya sayi naira 300 mai inganci, ya dauki matsayi na sama ya biya kusan naira 251 a danna, yayin da Installer B ya nemi naira 500 ya zauna kasa.

panel.rule: Sanin darajar abokin ciniki kafin ku saita kowane tayi.

say: Ga Tunde, wanda ke girka na’urorin hasken rana na gida a Ibadan. Waɗannan alkalumman misalai ne, don haka koyaushe ku yi amfani da lambobi na abokin cinikin ku.

card.title: Tunde, mai saka hasken rana a Ibadan

say: Matsakaicin aikinsa ya kai kimanin naira miliyan 1,200,000. Matsakaicinsa shine kashi 25%, don haka babban riba akan kowane aiki naira 300,000.

card.title: Tunde, mai saka hasken rana a Ibadan

say: Daga bayanansa, 1 cikin 10 tambayoyi ya zama aikin biya. Wannan kusan kashi 10% ne, don haka kowane gubar ya kai Naira 30,000.

card.title: Tunde, mai saka hasken rana a Ibadan

say: A shirye yake ya kashe kashi daya bisa uku na wannan tallace-tallace, don haka kudin da ake son kashewa akan kowane gubar naira 10,000.

card.title: Tunde, mai saka hasken rana a Ibadan

say: Shafin sabis ɗin sa yana juya kusan kashi 5% na masu ziyara zuwa tambayoyi. Don haka madaidaicin CPC ɗin sa ya kai naira 500.
Idan Keyword Planner ya nuna mafi yawan kalmominsa da kyau a ƙasa da haka, kasuwa yana aiki.

card.title: Tunde, mai saka hasken rana a Ibadan

say: Keyword Planner kayan aiki ne na kyauta a cikin Tallace-tallacen Google. Saita wurin zuwa yankin da kasuwancin ke hidima, kuma duba jeri na tayin.
Idan manyan tallace-tallacen sun zauna ƙasa da iyakar CPC ɗin ku, ci gaba. Fara da siyan kalmomi kamar farashi, kusa da ni ko shigar.

panel.heading: Kasuwar tana da araha?
left: Ƙididdigar girma a ƙasa da max CPC
Fara da kalmomin niyya mafi ƙarfi
Kalmomi kamar farashi, kusa da ni, shigar
right: Ƙaddamarwa da kyau sama da max CPC
Ko manufa mafi kunkuntar, sharuddan rahusa

say: Idan tallace-tallace sun fi iyakar CPC ɗinku, za ku yi asarar kuɗi akan yawancin dannawa. Haɓaka ƙimar jujjuyawa ko ƙimar kusa da farko, ko mafi ƙanƙanta, sharuɗɗan rahusa.

say: Wannan kuɗin abokin cinikin ku ne, don haka kare shi. Raba kasafin kuɗi na wata da 30.4 don samun kasafin kuɗin yau da kullun. Ga Tunde, Naira 300,000 a wata ya zama kusan Naira 9,900 a rana.
Ranar aiki na iya ciyarwa har sau 2 haka, amma watan yana tsayawa. Faɗa wa abokin ciniki kafin ƙaddamarwa, don haka rana mai aiki baya haifar da tsoro.
Kuma a sake duba jerin gwano kafin kowane tsari.

panel.heading: Kafin ka kaddamar da kowane kasafin kuɗi
items: Kasafin kudin wata-wata / 30.4 = kasafin yau da kullun
Ranar aiki na iya ciyarwa sau 2 a kowace rana
Watan yana tsayawa akan kwanaki 30.4
Faɗa wa abokin ciniki wannan kafin ƙaddamarwa
Sake bincika kewayon tayi kafin kowace shawara

say: Don tunawa. Tallace-tallacen bincike sun isa ga mutanen da suka riga sun faɗi abin da suke so, kuma inganci mai kyau na iya samun mafi kyawun wuri da ƙasa.
Ƙimar gubar ita ce babbar riba ta lokutan kusa. Matsakaicin farashin CPC shine ƙimar da ake so a kowane lokacin juyawa.
Lokacin da lambobi suka matse, ɗaga ƙimar jujjuyawa ko ƙimar kusa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Tallace-tallacen bincike sun isa ga mutanen da suka riga sun faɗi abin da suke so
Ad Rank yana saita matsayi; inganci na iya doke babban tayin
Ƙimar jagora = babbar riba x ƙimar kusa
Max CPC = farashin da aka yi niyya akan ƙimar jagora x
Haɓaka jujjuyawa ko kusa kuɗi don samun ƙarin kuɗi

say: Yanzu gwada shi akan kasuwanci na gaske. Tambayi mai shi don ƙimar siyarwa, gefe da ƙimar kusa, sannan aiwatar da ƙimar gubar da matsakaicin CPC.
Yi rikodin kalmomi guda 10 daga Maɓallin Maɓalli kuma yi alama ga kowane kore, amber ko ja. Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Tambayi mai shi na gaske don ƙimar siyarwa, gefe, ƙimar kusa
Yi aiki da ƙimar gubar da mafi girman CPC
Nemo keywords guda 10 a cikin Mai tsara Kalma
